last.verdict: Cut top end of guidance and weaker profit left investors unmoved, with shares flat.

reasons.label: Guidance range trimmed
reasons.text: 2026 contribution ex-TAC outlook cut to $215–225M from $215–235M; profit target held near $52M.

reasons.label: Big deals slipped
reasons.text: Two large agency agreements slipped; material contribution now expected late Q3, not Q2.

reasons.label: Profit fell sharply
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA fell 61% to $2.8M as promotions cut margins and search shrank 30%.

story: Perion guided 2026 growth in February and repeated it in May, promising a second-half ramp. May's results sent shares to their worst day in nearly two years. August's trimmed outlook and delayed deals left shares flat.
